aidan_quote_locked: S-tier tribes/comps: Beasts, Elementals, Demons, Undead (model should think these are strong); A-tier can be good; B-tier mostly avoid. Keep Naga excluded forever. Archlich Kel'Thuzad is NOT in the current Battlegrounds pool — never show as a strong card.

S.name: Beasts - Beetles
S.how_to_play: With early [[Ravaging Scorpid||132949]] or [[Turquoise Skitterer||119255]], start scaling the stats of beetles. [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] can help you generate pieces of the comp with the help of [[Snarky Shark||132804]]. Run as many [[Banana Slamma||98824]] as possible, as they double the attack of your beetles and helps deals with high HP boards.

S.name: Demons - Self Damage
S.how_to_play: The idea of this comp is to use effects such as [[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]], [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], or trinkets to deal damage to your hero, and [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] to negate this damage. [[Tichondrius||99228]] is some payoff for self damage, and used to stabilize in the midgame. Cupcakes generation with [[Eredar Escapist||133028]] is your main payoff for the lategame, targetting [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] to buff your shop. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles the effect of both Cupcakes and [[Devilish Distractor||132901]]. With [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], every single Demon played makes your next spell free which generates a ton of value. The best demon generation is from [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and cycling [[Imposing Percussionist||99232]].

S.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
S.summary: Play elementals to scale from big shop
S.how_to_play: Buff the shop with either [[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]] or [[Air Revenant||126173]], whichever method you find first. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] + [[Kelp Keeper||132883]] for massive economy and elemental generation. You may use [[Flaming Enforcer||126924]] to stabilize in the midgame, and [[Unbound Tempest||132983]] to cap out your scaling. With tempest, cycle premium elementals such as [[Sellemental||64038]] and [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]].

S.name: Undead - Attack Scaling
S.how_to_play: Scale the attack of your Undeads and summons with the Butchering spell from [[Drustfallen Butcher||120104]]. Butchering spell improves with spell scaling from [[Friendly Geist||120219]]. Your quality of summons come from [[Handless Forsaken||95265]]. [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] provides a ton of attack and health to your right most unit in combat, but also during the shop phase. Start using Butchering spells on your reborn cards with [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] on board to capture permanent stats. The best variation of this comp is to run [[Dead Bellringer||132322]] + [[Mummifier||108992]] to first reborn your entire board. Then, with a full hand of butchering and also Snazzy, use bellringer activate on the mummifier, then the bellringer will get reborn, and then butcher the bellringer, and repeat for all your butchering spells. This'll give you an insane amount of Snazzy procs.

A.name: Beasts - Tasty Lobstah
A.how_to_play: Trigger [[Tasty Lobster||132796]] deathrattle as many times as possible. This is done with multiple rallies + [[Deathstrider||132808]] and [[Titus Rivendare||97408]], triggering Lobster deathrattle upon every rally. Trigger the lobster deathrattle during shop phase using golden [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] and buying every [[Snarky Shark||132804]] and [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]]. Reborn taunt your lobster, and then windfury your Gryphon with [[Sprightly Scarab||108909]].

A.name: Elementals - Stat scaling
A.how_to_play: Buff your stat scaling through either [[Moat Custodian||132981]] or early [[Glowing Cinder||119951]]. Then, if you have Manasurge, cycle every good elemental ([[Sellemental||64038]], [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Sand Swirler||119949]]). It's even better if you cycle those cards with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]]. The best elemental engine in the game is [[Kelp Keeper||132883]] + [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] or [[Gentle Djinni]] if Murlocs are in. If your economy is really good you can add [[Unbound Tempest||132983]] while buffing the shop,

A.name: Mechs - Magnetics/Spells
A.how_to_play: Put targetted spells on mechs as much as possible with [[Glambot||132893]] on board. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles the effect. Best to have spell generation such as [[Captain Cookie||133075]]. Cycle good gem cards such as [[Fearless Foodie||113154]] and buy good spells such as 3 pointy arrow spell. Eventually, buy [[Utility Drone||98588]] to capitalize on the magnetics you attached with Glambot in the midgame.

A.name: Murlocs - Venom Scam
A.summary: Buy scam cards and try to preserve placements
A.how_to_play: Buy all the scam cards and try to preserve placements by killing as many units as possible. Keep your strongest units on the board (that's why you want to concentrate stats!) and fill the rest of the board with units that may be able to trade 1 for 1. Aim to golden [[Expert Aviator||126637]] and give it venom using [[Bile Spitter||122219]]. Then, the Aviator will pull many scam units from your hand. Could give murlocs permanent Venom using [[Sky-hatch Runaway||132957]] as well.

A.name: Murlocs - Tidecaller
A.how_to_play: First, have a ton of economy, typically starting from golden [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or Brann + [[Magicfin Mycologist||122277]], remembering premium economy spells such as Cloning Conch or Battlecry Discovery. Then, your payoff card for all that economy is [[Shamanic Tidecaller||133026]]. Paired with [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]], play as many spells on the tidecaller as possible, which could be bloodgems or [[Oozeling Gladiator||103670]] spells. Scale premium murlocs in hand such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] and [[Expert Aviator||126637]] so you can summon them and also [[Choral Mrrrglr||98948]] can capture all of the stats of the murlocs in your hand.

A.name: Undead - APM Undead
A.summary: Scale undead attack with infinite gold
A.how_to_play: [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] combined with [[Proud Privateer||122520]] gives you lots of gold to hit more of your setup.  Additional cards that help you become infinite include [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] and [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]], but can be cut once you commit more undeads to your board. Cycle every single free card ([[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]]) so you stay infinite. After you're infinite, scale undead attack using bounties + [[Forsaken Weaver||126733]]. Run a reborn golden [[Handless Forsaken||95265]] to be strong. Also use [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] and cycle every single destroy undead effect such as [[Maw Caster||121508]] and [[Disguised Graverobber||104610]] to destroy reborns and give snazzy permanent stats.

A.name: Dragons - APM Evoker
A.how_to_play: [[Fire-Forged Evoker||120301]] scales with the amount of spells you cast. Your spell generation comes from casting bounties with [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] and [[Proud Privateer||122520]]. Must be infinite with this comp, may use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] to help achieve that. Cycle every cheap card ([[River Skipper||122092]]) to spend gold and stay infinite. Leave [[Persistent Poet||108463]] on your board to capture permanent stats from Evoker. The best dragon to scale is [[Warpwing||92413]]. Get permanent divine shield and windfury on it using [[Amber guardian||95006]] and [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]] to end on in a turn.

A.name: Pirates - APM Golden
A.summary: Use infinite money to scale pirates
A.how_to_play: Go infinite with [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] + [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] + [[Proud Privateer||122520]] setup, [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] helps to get the ball rolling. With the escapee, you'll play a lot of goldens and discovers, both of which helps with [[Hooktusk, Master Marauder||132925]]. Scale by being infinite and buying discover effects.  ADVANCED PLAYERS: Pivot higher cap which is demons shop buff comp

A.name: Beasts - Summons
A.how_to_play: First, have [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] in the midgame to start generating many beasts and along the way, generate the core pieces to this comp. Then, proc [[Goldrinn, the Great Wolf||59955]] during shop phase with the help of [[Deathstrider||132808]]. [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] also doubles the effectiveness of this strategy. Force your Gryphon to attack using [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]] activate or cycling [[Snarky Shark||132804]]. Best case is when you chain shop attacks by generating more Lionfish and Sharks. Then, use [[Sewer Lord||130996]] and [[Banana Slamma||98824]] to benefit from the aura from Goldrinn and summon huge attack beasts.

A.name: Beasts - Leviathan
A.how_to_play: Summon as many beasts as possible after you get early [[Lurking Leviathan||130711]]. The best beast summoner is reborned [[Sewer lord||130996]]. Hoarding Hyena summons a taunt summon which is the next best. Then, paired with [[Banana Slamma||98824]], every summon will have a ton of attack.

A.name: Demons - APM Shop Buff
A.summary: Cast spells to consume buffed shop.
A.how_to_play: You must have an insane amount of economy to go for this comp. This is usually achieved with a turn 9 Brann + Rogers + Privateer. When you have too much economy, you will buy all targeted spells to use on [[Devilish Distractor||132901]] + [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] to scale the shop. You may also buff the shop cycling bloom gem buffers and buying every gem barrage card. You'll also generate a ton of spells by being infinite, allowing [[Felboar||110664]] or [[Twisted Wrathguard||130662]] to eat a huge shop over and over again. Brann and Escapee are additional tools to be infinite.

A.name: Demons - Shop Buff
A.how_to_play: Scale your shop with [[Devilish Distractor||132901]], best when paired with [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]]. Then, your payoff for the buffed shop is most commonly [[Felboar||110664]], but it could also be [[Twisted Wrathguard||130662]] and/or reborn [[Imp-lusionist||132899]]. Use [[Methodical Madness||132903]] spells on shops with Divine shield or Venomous to give these keywords to all your demons.

B.name: Murlocs - Family
B.how_to_play: Generate [[Papa Mrrglton||131147]] or [[Mama Mrrglton||131145]] early on with [[Cousin Errgl||131149]]. Use [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] to double the effect of all of these battlecries. [[Primalfin Lookout||60028]] is a great battlecry to cycle to generate more Papas and Mamas, and buy every Papa and Mama from shop as well. Leave a golden Mrrglton on your board to proc with [[Kelp Keeper||132883]]. Could choose to buff premium murlocs such as [[Bile Spitter||122219]] or [[Expert Aviator||126637]] that can summon scam units.

B.name: Quilboar - Bristlemane
B.summary: Cast spells on Quilboar to scale.
B.how_to_play: First, have gems scaled, usually with early [[Gem Rat||116434]]. Then, use [[Vigilant Bristlemane||132320]] to cast gems on the most premium card which is [[Blade Collector||99035]] or any premium dark gifts. Balinda is crucial to double Bristemane's effect. Concentrate all your gems on your juggernaut every turn using your Gem Confiscation from [[Trench Fighter||126671]]. In the endgame, starting filling out your board with ending units such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].

B.name: Mechs - Magnetics
B.how_to_play: With [[Spark Snapper||132676]], generate as many magnetics as possible so every magnet you play is huge. The best generation is [[Scrap Scraper||98592]]. Then, use [[Drone Duplicator||132312]] to duplicate a big magnetic a turn, preferable [[Accord-o-tron||98576]] for money.

B.name: Quilboar - Choose One
B.summary: Play Choose One cards to scale
B.how_to_play: First, have gem scaling, most commonly through [[Gem rat||116434]] but could be with [[Sanguine Refiner||122566]]. [[Turbo Hogrider||116195]] is the payoff for your gem scaling. It helps to have some choose one generation through [[Gem Rat||116434]] or [[Bramble Tunneler||132632]]. Additionally, cycle every decent choose one card (anything besides [[Intrepid Botanist||120223]] or [[Time Management||117573]]).

B.name: Dragons - Battlecries
B.how_to_play: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect||60630]] gives all of your dragons +4/4 every single battlecry you play. You want to trigger as many battlecries as possible. After you have your setup, cycle only PREMIUM battlecries, such as [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Shell Collector||80740]] or [[Draconic Warden||126860]]. The highest cap is to find as many double attack spell every turn, and permanently double the attack of warpwing every turn with the help of [[Persistent Poet||108463]]. Additionally, permanently attach divine shield with [[Amber Guardian||95006]] and permanently attach Windfury on Warpwing with [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]].

B.name: Mechs - Deathrattle
B.how_to_play: First, have a deathrattle midgame to have a scaled [[Falling Sky Golem||130798]] already. Taunt reborn it. Resummon it with [[Kangor's apprentice||59935]]. Fill out the rest of your board with scam such as [[Leeroy the Reckless||90425]].
